segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report reduced shine and clearer pores, with several saying it left skin oil-free without over-drying, though one found it made her face oilier when used on the face versus body.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: some say it does not dry them out and even helped milia and rough patches, while others found it drying, itchy, or too stripping for already-dry skin.
segments.combination: The one combination-skin reviewer reports it wipes off excess oil well without causing breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the largest group and mostly report no irritation, redness, or dryness with a gentle, fragrance-free clean, but a few describe itching, small bumps, or a rash, and several caution against daily use to avoid over-exfoliation.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her late 50s reports it exfoliates gently and gives a closer, smoother shave on facial hair.

concerns.aging: One mature reviewer reports smoother skin and easier shaving as an incidental benefit; no other aging-specific outcomes are mentioned.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say it left skin soft and hydrated without tightness, but multiple others report dryness, itchiness, or a need to pair it with a moisturizer to avoid over-drying.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers who mention redness say it did not cause any, including a sensitive-skin user who found other exfoliants too harsh by comparison, but one reviewer reports facial redness and itchy bumps after two weeks of use.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe it as protecting the skin barrier and avoiding tightness or irritation typical of salicylic acid washes, though one reviewer felt it worsened her skin barrier issues, leading to increased acne and PIE.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report improvement in closed comedones, dark spots, and post-acne marks, including visible reduction within a few days for one user, though one reviewer says her comedones tripled in size after use.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers with acne-prone skin report clearer skin, fewer breakouts, and calmer blemishes over weeks of use, but a smaller number report new whitehead breakouts, cystic-type flare-ups, or a rash after two weeks.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple oily-skin reviewers report reduced shine, smaller pores, and less oily skin after use, though one reviewer noted the opposite effect when applying it specifically to her face.

aspects.libelle: Over-drying with daily or facial use
Poor makeup removal on its own

So if you have sensitive don't use this on a daily basis. I would say once per week or every other week

I have VERY dry skin, so dry I only wash my face once a day every evening, and only rinse my face with water in the morning. I usually use a gentle hydrating cleanser, however I started getting milia bumps due to never being able to exfoliate. my skin has never been able to handle salicylic acid, however it can with this product! I've been using it 5 nights in a row and have not experienced any skin reactions, and have seen improvement in the milia bumps. I immediately follow up with a good moisturizer.

I rarely write reviews, but this is the best facial cleanser I have ever used. Ever. Cursed with very large, dark, stubborn nose pores and oil slick skin on my face since puberty (thanks dad) and with a couple of weeks using mainly this, my pores are smaller than a pin-head. Completely cleared out. It gently rinses away all oiliness on my skin as well, no over drying. But I feel like it may over dry if you don't have truly OILY skin type. I make sure to exfoliate really well before using this, so it's not wasted on trying to clear away a ton of dead skin and can actually get into my pores and treat them. Magical, gentle stuff for overly oily people who are on the sensitive side. Can't recommend enough.

I definitely recommend it to anyone with acne prone skin or just someone who needs a nice exfoliator! & a little goes a long way!!

extraits.titre: Great for smoothing skin on your body
extraits.texte: This product is great and I use it weekly on my body. My skin feels extremely smooth after using this product just one time and it goes on easily and does not leave a residue. Definitely not cost-effective if utilizing across your entire body, but weekly is an option. I tried utilizing this product on my face and noticed that my skin was extremely oily after use - I've stayed away from utilizing this on my face.
